name: Phu Yen chicken rice
summary: Lean, yellow, slightly chewy garden chicken over rice cooked in the chicken broth, so the rice stays light, fragrant, and sticky. Cucumber, pickled onion, and đồ chua come on the side.
origin: Phu Yen. Du lịch Phú Yên’s 6 October 2024 cẩm nang and its food roundup both describe cơm gà Phú Yên.
texture: The meat is lean, yellow, a little chewy, and sweet, and the rice is boiled in broth rather than fried.
taste: Cooking the rice in the broth keeps it light and fragrant. Rau răm and a sweet-sour fish sauce finish the plate.
howToEat: Eat the chicken and rice with the pickles, cucumber, and rau răm.
where: Lê Thánh Tôn, Lê Trung Kiên, Phan Đình Phùng, and Ngô Quyền.
seoTitle: Com ga Phu Yen — chicken rice, not the Hoi An plate
seoDescription: Lean yellow chicken over rice cooked in the broth, with pickles and rau ram. Not the Hoi An or Tam Ky plate.
culture: Phú Yên’s chicken rice is less famous than the plates of Hội An or Tam Kỳ. It is eaten at breakfast, lunch, dinner, and feasts.
